snippet.title: Geareo Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Build and experiment in Geareo, a mechanical physics sandbox focused on engineering, building, and creative problem-solving 

Design complex machines using realistic gears and physics-driven systems inside a LEGO-inspired building kit.

No grid limits! freely place and resize parts to create anything from simple mechanisms to advanced engineering contraptions.

⚙️ Realistic gear physics
🧩 No grids, fully resizable parts
📦 LEGO-style building kit
🧠 Creative physics challenges
